name: Beverly Wilshire, A Four Seasons Hotel
insider_take: This legendary Rodeo Drive icon has been the epitome of Hollywood glamour since 1928, famously starring as the backdrop for Pretty Woman and hosting countless A-list celebrities in its opulent suites.
whats_special: The hotel sits at the perfect intersection of Rodeo Drive and Wilshire Boulevard, making it ground zero for luxury shopping. Its Penthouse Presidential Suite spans an entire floor and has hosted royalty and heads of state. The property seamlessly blends Italian Renaissance architecture with modern Four Seasons luxury, featuring original marble columns and hand-painted ceilings.
pro_tip: Book a Rodeo Drive-facing room for prime people-watching and easy access to exclusive boutiques. The hotel's concierge can arrange private shopping appointments at nearby stores like Cartier and Tiffany & Co.
dont_miss: Afternoon tea at Blvd restaurant while watching the Rodeo Drive scene unfold, and a treatment at The Spa with its signature Beverly Hills Renewal facial. Take the iconic Pretty Woman shopping tour that starts right from the hotel's marble lobby.
pros: Iconic location on Rodeo Drive in heart of Beverly Hills
World-class Four Seasons luxury service and amenities
Historic Hollywood glamour with modern sophisticated elegance
Premium shopping and dining destination within walking distance
cons: Ultra-luxury pricing reflects premium Beverly Hills location
High-profile location may attract crowds and paparazzi
